matchmaking.pageDescription: Manage your network and sharing preferences
matchmaking.settingsDescription: Share your listings and mandates with other agencies for cross-agency matchmaking.

membership.label: Polis participation
membership.description: Choose how you want to connect with other agencies on the Oikion Polis network.
membership.NONEDesc: Your data is not shared with any other agency.
membership.NONEDetail: You will not receive cross-agency matches. You can enable this at any time.
membership.POOLDesc: Your shared data is visible to all pool members.
membership.POOLDetail: Automatic matchmaking with all participating agencies. Ideal for maximizing opportunities.
membership.BILATERALDesc: Your shared data is only visible to agencies you have accepted as partners.
membership.BILATERALDetail: Full control — you share data only with agencies you approve.
membership.BOTHDesc: Your shared data is visible to all pool members and your bilateral partners.
membership.BOTHDetail: Maximum visibility — combines the pool with exclusive bilateral relationships.

sharing.label: What to share
sharing.description: Control which data you share with your network partners.
sharing.propertiesDesc: Other agencies can match their mandates against your Polis-visible properties.
sharing.propertiesDetail: Only properties with SECURE or PUBLIC visibility are shared. HIDDEN and PRIVATE properties are never exposed.
sharing.mandatesDesc: Other agencies can match their properties against your Polis-visible mandates.
sharing.mandatesDetail: Only mandates with SECURE or PUBLIC visibility are shared. HIDDEN and PRIVATE mandates are never exposed.

privacy.ANONYMIZEDDesc: Specs only — no agency name or contact info.
privacy.AGENCY_IDENTIFIEDDesc: Specs + your agency name and logo.
privacy.FULLDesc: Specs + agency name + listing agent contact.

partners.title: Bilateral Partners
partners.description: Invite specific agencies to exchange data with — regardless of pool membership.
